Sudoku Game

A real Sudoku game with unique-solution puzzles — three difficulties, hints, live mistake checking, and win detection.

0

Select a cell, then tap a number.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a difficulty and press New game.
  2. Select a cell, then tap a number (1–9) or type it.
  3. Wrong entries turn red; use Hint when stuck.
  4. Complete every row, column, and 3×3 box to win.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the puzzles generated?

Each puzzle starts from a fully solved grid with cells removed one by one, keeping only removals that leave exactly one solution — verified by a backtracking solver.

What do the difficulties mean?

Easy starts with 45 given numbers, Medium with 35, and Hard with only 28 givens.

Does the game check my entries?

Yes — an entry that can't be part of the solution turns red immediately and adds to your Mistakes counter.

How do I win?

Fill every cell so each row, column, and 3×3 box contains the digits 1–9 exactly once.
